svg.title: The protocol on the left, the model on the right, and what is not modelled

g.text: EIP-8288 proposes
starksim represents it as
a transaction with dependencies
a post-quantum signature, or a STARK witness,
each large and each verified at every hop today
a wrapper, once per interval, per peer
transactions, or hashes the peer already has, plus either
mode 0: the raw witnesses, or
mode 1: one recursive proof, whatever the count
a peer verifies the proof, not the signatures
folds what it learned into its own next proof,
forwards its own wrapper; proofs grow recursively
a builder proves once more
over the transactions it includes; the block
carries a single proof for all of them
a leaf
kind q or p, a fee, an expiry, one bit in every mask;
bytes on the wire, a duration to verify, never invalid
a per-peer payload
bodies or hashes by what the sender believes the peer holds,
plus, in mode 1, a proof term: a claim mask and 262,144 B by default,
per peer per emission; in mode 0, the witnesses, verified one by one
a CPU job, then a view update
verification of configured duration on one CPU, then
admission into NodeView; the next tick selects and folds
greedy selection from one node's view
by claims, within a fold budget, bodies required;
attempted and newly included recorded separately

svg.text: proof validity or soundness · adversaries, free-riders, offline or heterogeneous nodes · execution, nonces, ordering, state conflicts
FOCIL and inclusion lists · reorgs and fork choice · a fee market beyond a scalar · validation against a client or a testnet
every participant is honest, identical, online and altruistic; every number in results.md inherits this list
